changelog:
Major update: Skill scope changed from a full-stack, multi-skill OPC AI framework to a specialized, professional financial and tax planning advisor for one-person companies.

- Replaced the comprehensive framework (previously 14 integrated business skills) with a targeted skill dedicated to OPC financial and tax compliance planning.
- Removed all individual skill modules related to business ideation, research, development, deployment, and operations.
- SKILL.md now focuses on tax category optimization, compliance risk avoidance, business type selection, and annual finance/tax calendar for solo founders.
- Output format designed for structured guidance: entity selection, tax optimization plan, compliance checklist, and yearly reminders.
